physical_effect_claim: A signed effect must have confidence intervals excluding zero with the same sign on both production grids. Mean absolute change of the per-flow effect between grids must be less than 10% of its measured mean magnitude. Otherwise report a statistical signal as unresolved at the tested resolution. This is an added strict claim criterion; it never relaxes trajectory gates.
common_probe: Report the change of the constructed impulse between grids, its constraint singular values, and its measured spatial extent. Instability of the intervention construction is a limitation even when the fluid solver passes.
independent_duration: Extend forced CPU comparisons from the initially planned 0.1 to the full primary horizon 0.4, both standard and tighter tolerances, for the first seed per viscosity. Add a same-pulse CPU comparison on the first smooth seed and the first lower-viscosity forced seed. No production effects have been examined.
